thread:
Priya: alert - apiserver fd count climbing fast in eu-central-1 starting 03:02 UTC, coincident with a bunch of GPU node attach failures. provisioning requests stuck in Pending state.
Tomas: seeing a reconnect storm from kubelets to apiserver, many 504s from NAT gateway 10.4.2.9. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/apiserver/fd-usage?var-region=eu-central-1
Lee: NetOpsBot flagged a transit switch rebooting (switch-7) at 03:00:42 and short link flaps 03:00:40-03:01:20. BGP peers re-advertised prefixes a few times.
NetOpsBot: event: transit-switch-7 rebooted by orchestration at 03:00:41, asymm routes observed for 38s.
SRE-Oncall: sample apiserver log: 
```
E0401 03:02:11.987654 1 wrap.go:42] http: Accept error: accept tcp 0.0.0.0:6443: accept4: too many open files
I0401 03:02:12.123456 1 watcher.go:172] watch reconnection from node/gpu-node-12 (resourceVersion: 1234567)
E0401 03:02:12.223456 1 controller.go:98] failed to reconcile GPUClaim/claim-42: api call timeout
```
Priya: controllers started aggressive retries for pending GPUClaims which created many watch/list requests; apiserver hit fd cap (set to 4096) and started refusing new connections.
Tomas: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon a subset of GPU nodes that are flapping to stop kubelet reconnect churn, 2) scale apiserver replicas 2->4 in region for headroom, 3) temporarily increase systemd LimitNOFILE for kube-apiserver container to 8192.
Lee: NetOps has taken switch-7 offline and rerouted flows via transit-8; BGP stability restored at 03:07.
SRE-Oncall: executed cordon on 20% of gpu pool (gpu-pool-eu-central), scaled apiserver, and rolled a kube-apiserver with higher ulimit. FD usage dropped to 64% by 03:09.
Priya: also disabled the GPUProvisioner aggressive create loop by flipping feature flag provisioner.enable_thundering_protect=false and set backoff to exponential (base 2s -> 8s).
Tomas: reminder - watch reconnection storms often amplify if watch cache size is small; added temporary config to increase watch-cache sizes for apiserver and lowered default response write timeout to avoid stuck handlers.
Lee: cost impact: extra apiserver replicas + rolling restart of control plane ~1.3% spike in infra spend for the region for 6h, approved by infra lead.
SRE-Oncall: follow-ups: 1) add transit-switch health gating to provisioning path so we can fail fast and avoid reconciler storms, 2) add alert when apiserver FD > 75% for >2m, 3) add reconciler backoff metrics to ksm dashboards.
Priya: filed INCIDENT-4999 and assigned to netops+provisioning to run a rehearsal for leader-election steady-state under transient network loss.
Tomas: small TODO - ensure controller-manager leader-election LeaseDuration is in sync across deploys; differences were causing fast failovers under flaps.
Lee: opened PR to provisioner: https://git.internal/r/PR-9344 to add jitter to job creation and better circuit-breaker behavior.
SRE-Oncall: monitoring for 3h; will escalate if any FD >80% or GPU claims backlog > 200. :eyes:
Priya: thanks team, seems like transit reboot triggered a watch/list reconverge -> reconciliation storm -> fd exhaustion -> provisioner backlog. Adding runbook entries now.
